description: Selects which retrieval strategy a SemanticSearchRequest uses against the target SearchIndex. SEMANTIC and HYBRID require at least one column on the index to be opted in to AOSS Automatic Semantic Enrichment via the resolved SearchConfiguration's columnSemanticEnrichment list; KEYWORD does not.

enum.name: KEYWORD
enum.description: Lexical match only. The query text is analyzed and matched against the indexed text fields using a standard OpenSearch match query, with no AOSS semantic rewriting forced or expected. Returned for parity so callers can A/B compare retrieval strategies through a single tool.

enum.name: SEMANTIC
enum.description: Semantic match only. The manager issues a match query against each semantic-enriched column on the target SearchIndex; AOSS auto-rewrites each such match into a neural sparse query under the hood per its documented behavior. No user-managed embedding model, dimension, or vector field is involved — the enrichment is service-managed.

enum.name: HYBRID
enum.description: Combined lexical and semantic retrieval using OpenSearch's hybrid compound query. The semantic match sub-queries (which AOSS rewrites to neural sparse) are combined with BM25 match sub-queries against the source text fields, scored through a normalization processor. Per the AOSS docs only min_max / l2 normalization and arithmetic_mean / geometric_mean / harmonic_mean combination techniques are available; the SemanticSearchRequest exposes the chosen technique and weights.
